description: Unit tests for the ProxyBypassRules class in Chromium, testing parsing, matching, and rule evaluation logic for proxy bypass rules.

classes.name: ProxyBypassRules
classes.description: Class representing a set of rules for bypassing proxies based on URL host patterns.

methods.name: ExpectRulesMatch
methods.description: Helper function to test if rules match a set of hosts across URL schemes.

methods.name: ExpectBypassLocalhost
methods.description: Helper function to test if localhost URLs are bypassed according to rules.

methods.name: ExpectBypassLinkLocal
methods.description: Helper function to test if link-local IP URLs are bypassed according to rules.

methods.name: ExpectBypassMisc
methods.description: Helper function to test if miscellaneous URLs are bypassed according to rules.
